summary: [para 11] 11. The Commission, vide order dated 31.8.2021 in Petition No. 355/TT/2019, has trued-up the tariff for the 2014-19 period and granted the tariff for the 2019-24 period. The capital cost of ₹1501.42 lakh has been approved by the Commission for the transmission asset as on 31.8.2021 in Petition No. 355/TT/2019, and the same capital cost has been considered as the opening capital cost as on 1.4.2019 for the purpose of truing-up of transmission tariff for 2019- 24 period in accordance with Regulation 19 [para 13] 13. We have considered the Petitioner’s submissions. The capital cost allowed for the transmission asset is as follows: [para 22] 22. Accordingly, the trued-up RoE allowed in respect of the transmission asset for the 2019-24 tariff period is as follows: [¶] the O&M Expenses claimed by the Petitioner in the instant true-up Petition is as per Regulation 35(3) of the 2019 Tariff Regulation. The O&M Expenses worked out in respect of the transmission asset are as follows: [para 31] 31. Accordingly, the Annual Fixed Charges (AFC) allowed after truing-up for the 2019-24 tariff period in respect of the transmission asset are as follows: [¶] capital cost has been considered as the opening capital cost for the transmission asset as on 1.4.2024 in accordance with Regulation 19(3) of the 2024 Tariff Regulations for the determination of the transmission tariff for the 2024-29 period. [para 64] 64. The Petitioner has submitted that as per Regulation 36(3)(d) of the 2024 Tariff Regulations, the security expenses and capital spares of more than ₹10 lakh and insurance expenses arrived through the competitive bidding for the transmission system and associated communication system shall be allowed separately after prudence check. [para 69] 69. On perusal of Regulation 36(3)(d) of the 2024 Tariff Regulations and considering the Petitioner’s submissions, the Petitioner is allowed to file a single consolidated Petition comprising of security expenses, capital spares individually costing more than ₹10 lakh and insurance expenses on an estimated basis in terms of the 2024 Tariff Regulations for the 2024-29 tariff period.
